text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm Vodka!
We're partners from here on out, so let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win races and become cooler than anyone else!
That's my ambition!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's why there's someone I can't lose to...!
I'm gonna be completely serious, so I'm countin' on you to be serious too!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
